page.text:
Two other notable derived connectives are the Sheffer stroke (NAND) and
the Peirce arrow (NOR). Each of these connectives is functionally
complete on its own, meaning that every truth-functional operator can be
expressed purely in terms of NAND alone or NOR alone.
